name: inspect
title: inspect
summary: A document's hierarchy as scene-to-text, or entities' full component state.
html:
A document's hierarchy as scene-to-text, or entities' full component state.

  • Scope: read
  • Service: core
  • MCP: ara_inspect

#Params

ParamRequiredDescription
docDocument: a path (levels/outpost.scene, or just outpost), asset ID or @path#id. Default: the document holding entities, else the project's main scene.
sessionyesSession handle from session.begin.
entitiesEntities to show in full: IDs, addresses (e_4f9a/e_m4tz) or name selectors (name:Crate, name:Gate/DoorLamp). Absent: a summary of the document's hierarchy.
depthHierarchy depth of the summary (default 2).
formattext (default) or json.
limitSummary page size (default 100).
cursornext from the previous summary page.
